sources.note: Nothing. Ch. 2 Phonology (pp. 32-65) treats vowels, consonants, tone (§2.6, p. 46: two register tones H/L plus marginal rising/falling contours, tone on every syllable), tonal variation (§2.7) and syllable structure (§2.8, p. 53-54); the word 'stress' occurs only twice in the whole thesis, both second-hand and not about Dompo (Siewierska's definition of independent pronouns, §3.9.3; Ameka's list of focus strategies, §5.6.2). No 'accent', 'prosody' or 'intonation' section.
